description: This file contains utility functions for registering decompositions of specific PyTorch operations within the JIT compiler, focusing on handling operation overloads and integrating with Torch's graph structures.

methods.name: None _register_decomposition(op: OpOverload, graph: torch._C.Graph)
methods.description: Registers a decomposition of a specific PyTorch operation overload into the given JIT graph, asserting that the overload is not a packet and is a specific overload.
